query:
SELECT c.id,
                   c.workspace_id,
                   c.channel_type AS "channel_type: ChannelType",
                   COALESCE((SELECT MAX(m.created_at) FROM messages m WHERE m.channel_id = c.id AND m.deleted_at IS NULL), c.created_at) AS "last_message_at!",
                   mine.unread_count,
                   ARRAY(
                       SELECT p.user_id FROM channel_members p
                       WHERE p.channel_id = c.id
                       ORDER BY p.joined_at, p.user_id
                   ) AS "participant_ids!",
                   COALESCE((
                       SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                                  'user_id', d.user_id,
                                  'display_name', u.display_name,
                                  'avatar_url', u.avatar_url,
                                  'left_at', d.left_at
                              ) ORDER BY d.left_at, d.user_id)
                         FROM conversation_departures d
                         JOIN users u ON u.id = d.user_id
                        WHERE d.channel_id = c.id
                   ), '[]'::jsonb) AS "departed!: Json<Vec<DepartedParticipant>>",
                   mine.notify_level AS "notify_level: NotifyLevel",
                   effective_notify_level(mine.notify_level, wm.notify_default, c.channel_type)
                       AS "effective_notify_level!: NotifyLevel"
              FROM channels c
              JOIN channel_members mine ON mine.channel_id = c.id AND mine.user_id = $2
              JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id = c.workspace_id AND wm.user_id = $2
             WHERE c.workspace_id = $1 AND c.channel_type IN ('dm', 'group_dm')
             ORDER BY 4 DESC
